title:	Refactor peephole optimization to plugin-based system using comonad pattern
state:	OPEN

## Summary

Build pluggable optimizer infrastructure for the Sea of Nodes IR, following the pattern established by `Chalk::IR::Optimizer::GVN`. This enables composable, testable optimization passes that can be easily added, removed, or reordered.

## Current State

**✅ Already Implemented (via Issue #113):**
- Polymorphic IR node hierarchy (`lib/Chalk/IR/Node/*.pm`)
- `Chalk::IR::Optimizer::GVN` - standalone optimizer with comprehensive tests
- `Chalk::IR::Node::Base::peephole($graph)` - hook for node-level optimizations
- Use-def chain infrastructure in `Chalk::IR::Graph`

**❌ Missing Infrastructure:**
- No composition framework for chaining multiple optimizers
- No unified way to enable/disable/reorder optimization passes
- Additional optimizers not yet implemented (constant folding, dead branch elimination, etc.)

## Proposed Architecture

### 1. OptimizerPipeline

Create `Chalk::IR::OptimizerPipeline` following GVN's pattern:

```perl
class Chalk::IR::OptimizerPipeline {
    field $optimizers :param :reader;
    
    method apply($graph) {
        my $current_graph = $graph;
        for my $optimizer ($optimizers->@*) {
            $current_graph = $optimizer->apply($current_graph);
        }
        return $current_graph;
    }
}
```

### 2. Additional Optimizer Plugins

Following `Chalk::IR::Optimizer::GVN` pattern, implement:

- `Chalk::IR::Optimizer::ConstantFolding` - compile-time arithmetic (2+3 → 5)
- `Chalk::IR::Optimizer::DeadBranchElimination` - remove unreachable code after constant conditions
- `Chalk::IR::Optimizer::PhiSimplification` - simplify phi nodes with identical inputs
- `Chalk::IR::Optimizer::AlgebraicSimplification` - identity laws (x+0 → x, x*1 → x)

### 3. Usage Example

```perl
my $pipeline = Chalk::IR::OptimizerPipeline->new(
    optimizers => [
        Chalk::IR::Optimizer::ConstantFolding->new(),
        Chalk::IR::Optimizer::DeadBranchElimination->new(),
        Chalk::IR::Optimizer::GVN->new(),
        Chalk::IR::Optimizer::PhiSimplification->new(),
    ]
);

my $optimized = $pipeline->apply($graph);
```

## Implementation Plan (TDD)

### Phase 1: Pipeline Infrastructure
- [ ] Create `Chalk::IR::OptimizerPipeline` class
- [ ] Write tests for pipeline composition (single, multiple, empty optimizers)
- [ ] Verify integration with existing GVN optimizer

### Phase 2: ConstantFolding Optimizer
- [ ] Write failing tests for arithmetic constant folding
- [ ] Implement `Chalk::IR::Optimizer::ConstantFolding`
- [ ] Test integration with pipeline

### Phase 3: DeadBranchElimination Optimizer
- [ ] Write failing tests for dead branch elimination
- [ ] Implement `Chalk::IR::Optimizer::DeadBranchElimination`
- [ ] Test with ConstantFolding (constant condition → dead branch removal)

### Phase 4: Additional Optimizers
- [ ] PhiSimplification optimizer
- [ ] AlgebraicSimplification optimizer

## Benefits

- ✅ Separation of concerns - each optimizer is isolated and focused
- ✅ Testability - test each optimizer independently with dedicated test files
- ✅ Composability - chain optimizers functionally, reorder as needed
- ✅ Extensibility - add new optimizers without touching existing code
- ✅ Consistency - follows established GVN pattern
- ✅ Performance tuning - enable/disable optimizers dynamically

## Success Criteria

- All existing tests continue to pass (109+ Sea of Nodes tests)
- Each optimizer has dedicated test file
- Pipeline composition works correctly
- New optimizations can be added without modifying existing code
- Performance is equivalent or better than current implementation

## References

- Existing optimizer: `lib/Chalk/IR/Optimizer/GVN.pm`
- Node base class: `lib/Chalk/IR/Node/Base.pm`
- Related Issue: #113 (Polymorphic node hierarchy - completed)

## Related Issues

- Supersedes original comonad-based proposal (implementation went different direction via #113)
- Future work: additional optimizations (loop strength reduction, induction variable analysis)
